label: data governance and management practices
definition: Practices concerning design choices, data collection origin, preparation operations, assumptions, bias assessment, mitigation measures, gap identification, and addressing shortcomings appropriate for the intended purpose of a high-risk AI system.
source_quote: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system

label: examination in view of possible biases
definition: An examination of data sets regarding possible biases likely to affect health and safety, negatively impact fundamental rights, or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law.
source_quote: examination in view of possible biases that are likely to affect the health and safety of persons, have a negative impact on fundamental rights or lead to discrimination prohibited under Union law

label: appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases
definition: Measures taken to detect, prevent, and mitigate possible biases identified in data sets that could affect health and safety or fundamental rights.
source_quote: appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases identified according to point (f)

label: identification of relevant data gaps or shortcomings
definition: The identification of relevant data gaps or shortcomings that prevent compliance with the Regulation and how those gaps can be addressed.
source_quote: the identification of relevant data gaps or shortcomings that prevent compliance with this Regulation, and how those gaps and shortcomings can be addressed

label: conditions for processing special categories of personal data
definition: Strict conditions including necessity for bias detection, technical limitations on re-use, security measures, prohibition of transmission, deletion after correction/retention period, and documentation of necessity.
source_quote: all the following conditions must be met in order for such processing to occur

label: processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data
definition: The requirement that bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data.
source_quote: the bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data

label: technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data
definition: Special categories of personal data must be subject to technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are subject to technical limitations on the re-use of the personal data

label: state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures
definition: Special categories of personal data must be subject to state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, including pseudonymisation.
source_quote: and state-of-the-art security and privacy-preserving measures, including pseudonymisation

label: measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards
definition: Special categories of personal data must be subject to measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards, including strict controls and documentation of the access.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are subject to measures to ensure that the personal data processed are secured, protected, subject to suitable safeguards, including strict controls and documentation of the access

label: not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties
definition: Special categories of personal data are not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are not to be transmitted, transferred or otherwise accessed by other parties

label: deletion once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period
definition: Special categories of personal data must be deleted once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period, whichever comes first.
source_quote: the special categories of personal data are deleted once the bias has been corrected or the personal data has reached the end of its retention period, whichever comes first

label: records of processing activities include the reasons why the processing was strictly necessary
definition: Records of processing activities must include the reasons why the processing of special categories of personal data was strictly necessary to detect and correct biases, and why that objective could not be achieved by processing other data.
source_quote: the records of processing activities pursuant to Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680 include the reasons why the processing of special categories of personal data was strictly necessary to detect and correct biases, and why that objective could not be achieved by processing other data
